title: Influence of nanoparticles and growth regulators on in vitro propagation of Kaempferia galanga L.: assessment of molecular clonal fidelity, phytochemical evaluation, and micro-anatomical characterization
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00742A, Paper
Babypyari Pamei, K. Nomita Devi, L. Anju Chanu, Nanaocha Sharma, Ningombam Bishwamitra Singh, Arunkumar Singh Koijam, Wagner A. Vendrame, Leimapokpam Tikendra, Potshangbam Nongdam
The graphical abstract illustrates the synthesis and characterization of ZnO and Ag nanoparticles. The nanoparticles enhanced in vitro propagation, maintained genetic and foliar stability, and improved phytochemical and antioxidant profiles.
